## Summary

The IEEE registry lists two MA-L blocks, 40:CA:63 and 88:57:1D, to Seongji Industry Company at 54-33 Dongtanhana 1-gil, Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do, South Korea [1]. No CVE naming the company was found in NVD [2].

Nothing else could be established. The candidate company site seongji.co.kr answered only with a script-gated cookie challenge, sjind.co.kr (titled Seongjin Industry) only frames another site, the FCC ID databases refused automated access, and the session's web search budget ran out before a product or teardown search could be made, so what a device in these blocks is, its radios, silicon, FCC grantee codes and randomization are all unknown.
